notes: Dress rehearsal of the mainnet deployment (Phase 4, D1). Same parameters as config/8453.json except the vaults, which the script deploys (two labelled TestnetVaults: plain ERC-4626, no yield, no admin), and the seed amounts, which fit Circle's testnet faucet. Addresses: Uniswap v4 deployments page and v4-periphery's broadcast log for 84532; Circle's USDC address list. allowEoaAdmin is true here so that a plain wallet can be the rehearsal admin; use a Safe if you want to rehearse the Safe flows too. Mainnet always requires a Safe.
